caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white pencil or graphite on a light beige background. The primary object in the center is a three-legged metallic stand or support structure, with each leg bent outward and ending in flat, rectangular feet. The central vertical section extends upward and terminates in a large, circular loop, with the metal appearing twisted slightly below the loop. There are two parallel elongated bars extending backward from the midpoint of the body, forming a support at the rear. Surrounding the main, shaded view are three additional technical sketch views: an elevation from the front (showing the outline of the stand), a side profile (showing the object’s thickness and twist at the loop), and a smaller schematic that appears to be a measurement or scale marked from 0 to 6 units. The entire composition is carefully shaded to convey the three-dimensionality and different perspectives of the object.
title: Andiron (One of Pair)
